tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

question.text: The statement that is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>INCORRECT</mi></math> about Ellingham diagram is

options.text: provides idea about the reaction rate.
provides idea about free energy change.
provides idea about changes in the phases during the reaction.
provides idea about reduction of metal oxide.

solution.text: Ellingham diagram is a plot between <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Δ</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">G</mi><mo>°</mo></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math> and does not give any information regarding rate of reaction
